notes: The breakout's 6-pin header is plugged into breadboard row j, columns 4-9 (ST, Z, Y, X, GND, VDD). The image's upper half (rows f-j) is bank 'b' in the catalogue naming. Each jumper wire goes into the same column in a different row of the same strip. The exact rows are read from the picture and are approximate.

A4 is driven LOW as ground and A5 HIGH as 5 V (digital pins 18 and 19). Both connections are made with jumper wires to the Uno's analog pins, as in the tutorial. Z, Y and X go to A1, A2 and A3, following the circuit image and the pin table. The schematic's X/Z crossing is not followed.
The tutorial warns that some ADXL3xx breakouts need a 3.3 V supply and can be damaged by 5 V. The SparkFun breakout shown runs from the 5 V on A5, as the tutorial describes.
The tutorial lists no resistors, LEDs or buttons, so none are added.
